description: This file implements Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) functionality for Mattermost, including secret generation, activation, deactivation, and token validation.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Interface for MFA data storage operations, including updating activation status, storing secrets, and managing used timestamps.

classes.name: MFA
classes.description: Main struct for MFA operations, holding a reference to a Store implementation.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructor for MFA struct, initializes with a Store.

methods.name: GenerateSecret
methods.description: Generates a new MFA secret, creates a QR code, and stores the secret.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates MFA for a user after verifying the token.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates MFA for a user and clears the secret.

methods.name: ValidateToken
methods.description: Validates a provided MFA token for a user.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Internal method to verify MFA token using the secret and used timestamps.
